English: Mudbrick Houses
Simple dwellings of sun-baked earth, clustered together for shelter at the edge of a growing settlement.
Timber Cottages
Small wooden cottages raised by settlers, offering greater comfort and permanence than mudbrick shacks.
Wattle-and-Daub Homes
Dwellings of woven wood and daubed clay, providing improved shelter, sanitation, and space for families.
Stone Dwellings
Solid stone homes for prosperous burghers, offering greater safety and durability within the city walls.
Patrician Villas
Lavish homes for the citys most influential citizens, set apart with gardens and private courtyards, hosting the citys elite.
Rowhouses
Multi-family brick and stone structures built shoulder-to-shoulder, maximizing urban space and tax revenue.
Courtyard Estates
Expansive estates with grand courtyards, administrative offices, and workshops, serving as centers of urban governance.
Noble Manors
Stately manors for landed nobility, combining luxury residences with administrative halls and fortified gates.
Tenement Blocks
Towering tenement blocks housing hundreds of city dwellers, enabling a bustling urban economy and formidable defense.
Grand Townhouses
Magnificent multi-story townhouses, home to powerful merchant dynasties and urban nobility, dominating the citys skyline.
